create_optimizer_context: create an OptimizerContext dataclass with training args, model, optimizer kwargs, adam kwargs, and optim args
parse_optimizer_args: parse a comma-separated string of key=value optimizer arguments into a dictionary
setup_low_rank_optimizer: set up a low-rank optimizer like GaLore or Apollo with target linear module parameter splitting
check_optimizer_factory: check if an optimizer handler returns a factory callable rather than a torch.optim.Optimizer subclass
get_bitsandbytes_optimizer: get a bitsandbytes optimizer such as 8bit AdamW, Lion, RMSprop, or AdEMAMix with paged and optim_bits options
